integrity: The full claim has an explicit mathematical proof, independent finite consistency checks, qualified literature-overlap comparisons and documented residual historical-priority risk. No independent mathematical audit or external certification is asserted.
limitations: The theorem concerns only dimension at least two, nonzero one-dimensional square, zero annihilator, and finite fields of characteristic two with at least four elements. It counts basis classes, not isomorphism classes of algebras. It does not treat odd characteristic or arbitrary evolution-algebra graphs; finite checks are not the infinite proof.
title: Exact natural-basis graph spectra for rank-one evolution algebras in characteristic two
